written: 2026-11-16, committed before the controls and the long run of the second G22 fix are measured on a runner (the commit that adds this file is the timestamp)
phase: camera 6a, G22's judged set, round 2: the barycentric rounding of a far, grazing triangle (CI red, maddening-main shard 26 of PR 341)
labels: the fix round agent's predictions. Seen before: the failing draw fails float32 and not float64, on the released MADDENING and its main; the f32 crossing test returns not-crossed for both triangles of a fold the oracle crosses at 1.2e-4 and 3.1e-4 barycentric, with the f32 barycentrics off by 1.3e-4 and 3.4e-4; the derived bound 4 eps (S/L) shape / cos held on 70 000 near-edge pairs at 0.13 (float32) and 0.32 (float64) of itself and is 8.0e-3 and 2.1e-2 on the failing ray; with the fix the draw passes in both dtypes on both MADDENING versions; without it the pinned example fails float32

operating_point.platform: CPU; GitHub runner, 4 vCPU, probe branch, one arm a job
operating_point.sizes_and_parameters: G22 as written: 40 examples a dtype in the controls, 1500 examples a dtype in the long run, one to three closed meshes 25 um to 1 mm, 192 rays, origins within 5 mm

gate_long_run.claim: no draw fails with the derived barycentric band: the long run of 1500 examples in each dtype passes

prediction.basis: estimated: round 1's long run (1500 a dtype) did not reach this draw, whose rate is about one in 1500 to 3000 draws on the CI's evidence; the band is a derived upper bound measured at 0.13 to 0.32 of itself
prediction.why: a failure left would be a rounding larger than the bound, a miss of the tree, or a third class

gate_long_run.if_wrong: a failure is classified before anything changes: a rounding above the bound refutes the derivation; a fewer-crossings ray whose triangles are not within the band is a real miss

gate_tied_fraction.claim: the derived band leaves out few rays: the fraction of rays tied in the long run's draws
gate_tied_fraction.case: the long run's counts (tied, and the rays the old margin left out)

prediction.basis: estimated: a ray is within the band of an edge of some triangle in front with probability about (number of triangles in front, a few to tens) times the band (1e-5 to 1e-2); round 1 measured 6e-4 and 1.3e-3 for the origin ties alone
prediction.why: the band is wide only for far, thin, grazing triangles, which a ray meets rarely

gate_tied_fraction.if_wrong: above 0.05 the gate has lost its power: the controls say whether it still catches the plants

gate_controls.claim: each planted error is caught every run in each dtype, with the derived band in the judged set, and no clean run is flagged
gate_controls.case: test_the_tree_finds_every_crossing_brute_force_finds with CAMERA_PLANT = dropped-leaf, flipped-winding, shrunk-box, by .github/probe/detection_rate.py, 30 runs a dtype (arms plant-dropped-leaf, plant-flipped-winding, plant-shrunk-box), the clean arm 30 runs a dtype in the shrunk-box arm

prediction.basis: measured-before: round 1's controls, 30/30 each in each dtype and clean 0/30, with the t-tie band; the derived band only leaves out more rays near edges
prediction.why: each plant is a whole crossing or 2t on the chord, above rounding, on rays aimed at the interior of triangles at barycentric weights of at least 0.05

gate_controls.if_wrong: a plant missed on a run: the tied set took its only judged rays; the plant is aimed at the triangle the judged rays cross most, and the test asserts one does

gate_bits.claim: no program of 6a changes: the diff holds no file under src/
gate_bits.if_wrong: a file under src/ in the diff
